paragraphs.source_en: As she watched Kyuroku carrying those keepsakes and the portrait, Odai felt that life was like a sorrowful dream. No one now would have imagined that he was Tōkurō Nobuchika, younger brother of the lord of Kariya Castle.

units.source_en: As she watched Kyuroku carrying those keepsakes and the portrait, Odai felt that life was like a sorrowful dream.
units.source_zh: 看着手携那些纪念品和画像的久六，於大便觉人生如同一场悲伤的梦。

units.source_en: No one now would have imagined that he was Tōkurō Nobuchika, younger brother of the lord of Kariya Castle.
units.source_zh: 如今，谁也不会认为他就是藤九郎信近、刈谷城主的弟弟。

paragraphs.source_zh: 看着手携那些纪念品和画像的久六，於大便觉人生如同一场悲伤的梦。如今，谁也不会认为他就是藤九郎信近、刈谷城主的弟弟。

paragraphs.source_en: The two followed a narrow, winding path strewn with fallen leaves toward Ogawa. Kenkon-in at Ogawa was the temple where generations of the Mizuno family had been enshrined. But the moment Odai saw its lofty temple gate, her feelings abruptly changed. Her elder brother, Shimotsuke-no-kami Nobumoto, was in the Oda camp. If anyone recognized that articles belonging to the Matsudaira family had been dedicated here, it might cause serious trouble.

units.source_en: The two followed a narrow, winding path strewn with fallen leaves toward Ogawa.
units.source_zh: 二人沿着落满枯叶的羊肠小道，向绪川走去。

units.source_en: Kenkon-in at Ogawa was the temple where generations of the Mizuno family had been enshrined.
units.source_zh: 绪川的乾坤院是水野家祖祖辈辈供奉的寺庙。

units.source_en: But the moment Odai saw its lofty temple gate, her feelings abruptly changed.
units.source_zh: 但是，一看到那高大的山门，於大的心情突然变了。

units.source_en: Her elder brother, Shimotsuke-no-kami Nobumoto, was in the Oda camp.
units.source_zh: 兄长下野守信元身在织田阵营。

units.source_en: If anyone recognized that articles belonging to the Matsudaira family had been dedicated here, it might cause serious trouble.
units.source_zh: 如果有人看出松平家的东西被供奉在此，也许会惹出大事。

paragraphs.source_zh: 二人沿着落满枯叶的羊肠小道，向绪川走去。绪川的乾坤院是水野家祖祖辈辈供奉的寺庙。但是，一看到那高大的山门，於大的心情突然变了。兄长下野守信元身在织田阵营。如果有人看出松平家的东西被供奉在此，也许会惹出大事。

units.source_en: “Kyuroku.”
units.source_zh: “久六。”

units.source_en: “My lady.”
units.source_zh: “夫人。”

paragraphs.source_en: “We should offer these things to Ryōgon-ji in Kariya instead. My elder brother Nobuchika’s grave is there.”

units.source_en: “We should offer these things to Ryōgon-ji in Kariya instead.
units.source_zh: “这些东西，还是献给刈谷的楞严寺吧。

units.source_en: My elder brother Nobuchika’s grave is there.”
units.source_zh: 在那座寺里，有我的兄长信近的坟墓。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “这些东西，还是献给刈谷的楞严寺吧。在那座寺里，有我的兄长信近的坟墓。”

paragraphs.source_en: Nobuchika himself knew that his own “grave” was there, and he replied, “As you command.”

units.source_en: Nobuchika himself knew that his own “grave” was there, and he replied, “As you command.”

ja.t: っており、「かしこまりました」と

units.source_zh: 信近也知道自己的“坟墓”在那里，道：“遵命。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 信近也知道自己的“坟墓”在那里，道：“遵命。”

paragraphs.source_en: And so the two set off once more, crossing the desolate fields toward Kariya. The sky was brilliantly clear, yet the leafless trees swayed in the wind with a sound like weeping.

units.source_en: And so the two set off once more, crossing the desolate fields toward Kariya.
units.source_zh: 于是，二人又穿过萧瑟的田野，向刈谷而去。

units.source_en: The sky was brilliantly clear, yet the leafless trees swayed in the wind with a sound like weeping.
units.source_zh: 天空响晴，枯树却发出哭泣般的声音，在风中摇摆。

paragraphs.source_zh: 于是，二人又穿过萧瑟的田野，向刈谷而去。天空响晴，枯树却发出哭泣般的声音，在风中摇摆。

paragraphs.source_en: What saddened them still more, however, was the wooden house that stood on the way from the Kuma residence to Ryōgon-ji. The trees there still tossed their withered branches in the cold wind, and the thought that Kayō-in had once wept her heart out in that place made the sight almost unbearable for them. Their mother had been forced to leave five children behind and marry into a family in Okazaki. Thinking of her mother, Odai felt that her own misfortunes were insignificant; yet the sound of the bare trees only deepened her melancholy, and she quickened her pace despite herself.

units.source_en: What saddened them still more, however, was the wooden house that stood on the way from the Kuma residence to Ryōgon-ji.
units.source_zh: 但令二人更感悲伤的，是那座位于熊邸通往楞严寺途中的木房子。

units.source_en: The trees there still tossed their withered branches in the cold wind, and the thought that Kayō-in had once wept her heart out in that place made the sight almost unbearable for them.
units.source_zh: 那里的树木仍在冷风中摇晃着枯萎的枝干，一想到华阳院曾在那里以泪洗面，二人愈觉难以忍受。

units.source_en: Their mother had been forced to leave five children behind and marry into a family in Okazaki.
units.source_zh: 母亲被迫抛下五个孩子，嫁到冈崎。

units.source_en: Thinking of her mother, Odai felt that her own misfortunes were insignificant; yet the sound of the bare trees only deepened her melancholy, and she quickened her pace despite herself.
units.source_zh: 想起母亲，於大觉得自己的不幸实微不足道，但枯树的声音又让她愈是抑郁，她不禁加快了步伐。

paragraphs.source_zh: 但令二人更感悲伤的，是那座位于熊邸通往楞严寺途中的木房子。那里的树木仍在冷风中摇晃着枯萎的枝干，一想到华阳院曾在那里以泪洗面，二人愈觉难以忍受。母亲被迫抛下五个孩子，嫁到冈崎。想起母亲，於大觉得自己的不幸实微不足道，但枯树的声音又让她愈是抑郁，她不禁加快了步伐。

paragraphs.source_en: Kyuroku must have felt the same. “My lady, do not look any longer.” Whenever Odai stopped, he turned back to urge her onward. By the time they reached Ryōgon-ji, the Hour of the Sheep had already passed. Shown inside by one of the temple monks, they first paid their respects at their father’s grave, which had been moved there from Ogawa.

units.source_en: Kyuroku must have felt the same.
units.source_zh: 久六想必也是同样的想法。

units.source_en: “My lady, do not look any longer.”
units.source_zh: “夫人，莫要再看了。”

units.source_en: Whenever Odai stopped, he turned back to urge her onward.
units.source_zh: 每当於大停下脚步，他便转过身去催促。

units.source_en: By the time they reached Ryōgon-ji, the Hour of the Sheep had already passed.
units.source_zh: 到楞严寺时，未时已过。

units.source_en: Shown inside by one of the temple monks, they first paid their respects at their father’s grave, which had been moved there from Ogawa.
units.source_zh: 被寺中和尚领进去，二人首先参拜了从绪川移过来的父亲之墓。

paragraphs.source_zh: 久六想必也是同样的想法。“夫人，莫要再看了。”每当於大停下脚步，他便转过身去催促。到楞严寺时，未时已过。被寺中和尚领进去，二人首先参拜了从绪川移过来的父亲之墓。

paragraphs.source_en: Shimotsuke-no-kami Nobumoto and one of the temple monks had become friends through linked verse, and a small new burial plot had been opened here; a gravestone stood in one corner, but the name Tōkurō Nobuchika had not been carved upon it.

units.source_en: Shimotsuke-no-kami Nobumoto and one of the temple monks had become friends through linked verse, and a small new burial plot had been opened here; a gravestone stood in one corner, but the name Tōkurō Nobuchika had not been carved upon it.
units.source_zh: 下野守信元和寺中和尚因连歌而成为朋友，在此新开辟了一小块墓地，在墓地角落里竖着墓碑，但上面并未刻有藤九郎信近的名字。

paragraphs.source_zh: 下野守信元和寺中和尚因连歌而成为朋友，在此新开辟了一小块墓地，在墓地角落里竖着墓碑，但上面并未刻有藤九郎信近的名字。

paragraphs.source_en: At last Kyuroku spoke to Odai in the voice of an elder brother: “Tōkurō Nobuchika’s grave is already overgrown with moss. Lady Odai, you too may bury your sorrows here. Everything can change...” Odai nodded and remained silent for a long while.

units.source_en: At last Kyuroku spoke to Odai in the voice of an elder brother: “Tōkurō Nobuchika’s grave is already overgrown with moss.
units.source_zh: 久六终以兄长的口吻对於大说道：“藤九郎信近的坟墓已经长满苔藓。

units.source_en: Lady Odai, you too may bury your sorrows here.
units.source_zh: 於大小姐也可以将烦恼埋葬于此。

units.source_en: Everything can change...” Odai nodded and remained silent for a long while.
units.source_zh: 一切都可以改变⋯⋯”於大点点头，半晌没有说话。

paragraphs.source_zh: 久六终以兄长的口吻对於大说道：“藤九郎信近的坟墓已经长满苔藓。於大小姐也可以将烦恼埋葬于此。一切都可以改变⋯⋯”於大点点头，半晌没有说话。

paragraphs.source_en: Odai’s heart overflowed with emotion, and she could not utter a single word. Standing behind Odai, Kyuroku took the teacup with a somber gaze. Across from the graveyard, the leafless trees were still moaning in the woods...

units.source_en: Odai’s heart overflowed with emotion, and she could not utter a single word.

units.source_zh: 於大心中感慨万千，一句话也说不出来。

units.source_en: Standing behind Odai, Kyuroku took the teacup with a somber gaze.
units.source_zh: 久六站在於大身后，目光沉郁地接过茶碗。

units.source_en: Across from the graveyard, the leafless trees were still moaning in the woods...
